name: Bottled Quantum Ghost
description: Upon use, decreases all enemies' SPD by 15% for the next battle.
story:
A Table Top pet existing in a quantum state. Lively, cute, and highly interactive. In principle, all "Bottled Quantum Ghosts" are just different observational results of the same individual entity, so buyers don't need to feed it at all. The manufacturer handles feeding centrally.

"To avoid implosion, do not open the bottle under any circumstances. If the bottle breaks, please contact the Department of Aberration Defense immediately."
